ref_text: The night was cold and very quiet. Most of the street was asleep, and the lamps hummed over the empty road. Somewhere far away, a train rolled past, and then the silence came back.

lines.text: You've got five seconds before this stall gets robbed.
Five men were at the stall.
Whoever you pick goes to jail.
Did you actually see him take it?
Number three never left his seat.
For once, the man with the mole did nothing.
Number four took it, in plain view.
So if you chose number three, he spent the night in a cell.
You chose the first face you saw, not the one that took it.
And unless you chose number four, he walked off with the cash box.
